title: Scraft TAB
description: Professional customization of TAB and chat with gradients and advanced moderation.
body:
Professional customization of TAB and chat with gradients and advanced moderation.

ScraftTAB is a powerful tool for server owners who want to stand out. A complete redesign of the standard Minecraft interface using the Adventure API and support for RGB gradients.

Key features:
Gradient TAB - Header and Footer with smooth color transitions.

Rank presets system - Owner, Moderation, and Player with unique HEX gradients.

Anti-Mate - It doesn't ban the player, but it doesn't send a message to the chat + it doesn't allow the word to be written in the chat

 Moderator Mode - Automatic activation of Fly, Spectator, and God Mode.

 Cross-Platform - Native support for Paper, PurPur, and fallback to Bukkit/Spigot.
